The '''Gundark Enclosure''' on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] was a area using a [[Force field/Legends|force-field]] to enclose a [[Gundark/Legends|Gundark]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac]]. A small camp was located outside the force-field. A group of scientists were studying it from a safe distance outside of the force-field.

==Behind the scenes==
This Gundark Enclosure first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]" as a location on Carlac that serves no purpose.
